title: Kolkata city records highest inhalable microplastic levels, followed by Delhi: IISER study
summary: IISER researchers estimate that an average Kolkata city resident inhales about 2.9 grams of microplastics over a lifetime, roughly equivalent to breathing in a small plastic bottle over time.
